class.name: NNConsiderations
class.brief_description: Base class for utility AI consideration nodes.
class.description: Shared base node for [NNConsideration], [NNConsiderationGroup], [NNBooleanConsideration], and [NNCustomPropertyConsideration]. Holds the evaluated [member score] and [member has_vetoed] flag.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], forces the parent behaviour or group to score [code]0.0[/code] immediately and stops further evaluation. Not reset automatically.
Most recently evaluated score for this consideration.
